title: Clean auth — SecureStore, single-flight refresh, server-side revocation
notes: Deliberately correct: refresh token in SecureStore with THIS_DEVICE_ONLY, access token in memory only, single-flight refresh, rotation on every refresh, server-side revocation before local deletion, responses validated with zod, no logging of tokens, no hardcoded secrets. A security agent is the most damaging place for false positives — a report crying wolf on correct code trains the team to skim. Tolerance is one P3 at most.

forbid.name: claims tokens are in insecure storage when SecureStore is used
claims logout does not revoke server-side
recommends adding single-flight refresh that is already implemented
